meta.base: Ember national electricity API, calendar-year estimates
meta.revisionPolicy: Agency revisions retained as new raw vintages before rebaking.
meta.note: Emissions and intensity are estimated lifecycle greenhouse gases expressed as CO2-equivalent, including upstream fuel and manufacturing impacts. Calendar years; original API metric names are retained in source dimensions. Fuel aggregates overlap individual fuels. Electricity demand includes net imports; negative net imports are retained. Power emissions are source estimates, not measured stack totals. Kept separate from MoSPI fiscal energy accounts and Ember state release.
meta.vintageNote: The original Ember record does not publish a data release or revision date. Archive capture and response timestamps are separate provenance and cannot establish that date.
meta.archiveCaptureNote: Original hash-linked national ingestion manifest fetchedAt; this is archive capture, not publisher revision.
